Keypair generated. Here's your one action — run this once on the M910S (PowerShell, as the user account) to authorize my key:

$key="ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIDiFZRb6Lf2yWe+2Zy0bIKSUlXqV/lbS0qhnC5jkWcGC ubuntu@VM-0-3-ubuntu"
$dir="$env:USERPROFILE\.ssh"
if(!(Test-Path $dir)){mkdir $dir}
Add-Content -Path "$dir\authorized_keys" -Value $key
icacls "$dir\authorized_keys" /inheritance:r /grant:r "$env:USERNAME:(R)"


That adds my public key to your user account's authorized_keys and locks permissions (Windows OpenSSH requires that). 

Then tell me and I'll SSH in from the VPS:
ssh user@100.113.7.12


If user isn't the exact SSH login name on the M910S, replace it — or just tell me the correct username and I'll adjust. Once I'm in, I'll diagnose the 5B model slowness (find how it's launched, check GPU/quant, fix it) and confirm control works.

Run that PowerShell command on the M910S and say "done" (or give me the real username if it differs).
